headline: Elon Musk posted "Dot.com" on X as that web address began sending visitors to xAI's Grok Bot, widely read as a dig at OpenAI's new Dots agents.
score_reason: Pool score 2 lowered by 1: the redirect story began on 29 Sep 2026 and was covered on 1 and 2 Oct, so this 5 Oct report is a late re-run.
importance_line: It is a public jab between two rival makers of AI agents, of interest to users weighing OpenAI's Dots against xAI's Grok Bot; the domain moved to xAI in July, before Dots was announced, and xAI has not said why it bought it, so intent is unproven.
summary: Moneycontrol reports that Elon Musk shared a post by investor Paul Graham on X with the single word "Dot.com" as the web address dot.com now redirects to the page for Grok Bot, an AI agent from his company xAI, a move widely read as a dig at OpenAI's Dots, the task-performing AI agents that OpenAI unveiled on 29 Sep 2026, according to TechJuice. Citing an earlier report it does not name, Moneycontrol adds that the domain was transferred to xAI in July, before Dots was announced, so the redirect was not necessarily a response, and xAI has not explained why it bought it.
notes: Reply story: Musk's post names no one, so it is 'widely read as' a dig at OpenAI. The story began on 29 Sep 2026 and was covered on 1 and 2 Oct; Moneycontrol re-ran it on 5 Oct. The date of Musk's own post is not given. Moneycontrol rests on an unnamed report; the 29 Sep launch date is from TechJuice.
